_comment: Runtime config for دانلودیار (ir.amgroup.instadl).
The app fetches this file once a day and caches it. Everything in it is
optional: a fetch that fails, times out, or returns malformed JSON leaves
the app running on its compiled-in defaults. That is deliberate, because
this host is not always reachable from Iran.
HOW TO EDIT AFTER A RELEASE — see UPDATING.md next to this file.
update.latestVersionCode      the versionCode now on Bazaar
update.minSupportedVersionCode  builds BELOW this are told they must
update. Raise it ONLY when an older build
genuinely cannot work any more. A forced
update that is merely convenient for us
bricks the app for someone who cannot
reach Bazaar right now.
update.message                optional one line shown instead of the
stock sentence. Plain text, no markup.
graphqlDocId                  set this when Instagram rotates its doc_id
and reels start resolving to a poster
image only. Fixes the app without waiting
days for a Bazaar review.
promo                         the apps shown in the bottom bar; same
shape as assets/promo/apps.json in the
project. NEVER offer a reward for
installing — Bazaar bans that outright.
